trigger_condition: retry_after_seconds is negative, zero, or non-finite
guard_snippet: const sec = Number.isFinite(retrySeconds) && retrySeconds > 0 ? retrySeconds : 2; this.pausedUntilMs = nowMs + sec * 1_000;
potential_consequence: pausedUntilMs becomes past or NaN; rate_limited pause is effectively skipped

trigger_condition: Offline scenario requested at any tick
guard_snippet: if (graceTick < 5) return { kind:'metrics', metrics: ... }; else return { kind:'offline' };
potential_consequence: No 5-tick grace period: device stops emitting at tick 0 instead of after grace

trigger_condition: socket.disconnect(true) fires a 'disconnect' event on the same socket
guard_snippet: this.stopped = true; this.socket?.disconnect(true); this.socket = null; this.scheduleReconnect();
potential_consequence: Reconnect handler fires from our own disconnect, doubling reconnect attempts every envelope

trigger_condition: buffer flushed to server without clearing the buffer
guard_snippet: this.buffer = []; this.overflowLoggedThisRun = false; before the for-loop emit
potential_consequence: Buffer grows monotonically across reconnect cycles until overflow or envelope drop
Reconnect uses the same forbidden token; infinite backoff loop

trigger_condition: persist_failed arrives while buffer length is 0
potential_consequence: drops a frame from the next-tick cycle after reconnect instead of the persisted one

trigger_condition: CLOCK_SKEW_DETECT_MS drift between wall-clock and frame ts
potential_consequence: No defensive clock-skew guard before send; spec FRAME_TS_NEAR_NOW contract unmet

trigger_condition: multiple connect_error events before first successful connect
potential_consequence: Overlapping reconnect timers scheduled; backoff counter double-increments

trigger_condition: this.opts.now and defaultNow invoked twice in one tick
guard_snippet: const nowMs = (this.opts.now ?? defaultNow)(); const ts = nowMs; // reuse
potential_consequence: Skew between paused-window check timestamp and frame ts

guard_snippet: const failsThisTick = tickCount > 0 && tickCount % failPeriod === 0; // guard
potential_consequence: NaN ph emitted on every negative multiple of 20, bypassing the 'NaN only on positive ticks' contract

trigger_condition: bad_request arrives while socket is disconnected and buffer is empty
potential_consequence: Drops an unrelated next-candidate frame from buffer

trigger_condition: disconnect fires while a reconnect timer is already scheduled
potential_consequence: Backoff counter resumes from existing pending timer instead of resetting; spec reset-on-success only
Frame lost during failing dispatch; unhandled exception terminates process

trigger_condition: scheduleNextTick(0) fires before socket.io handshake completes
potential_consequence: First frame buffered instead of sent; seq=1 frame never reaches wire until reconnect

trigger_condition: devices.json size grows large (no size cap on readFileSync)
guard_snippet: const stat = statSync(filePath); if (stat.size > MAX_DEVICES_BYTES) failFast(...); raw = JSON.parse(readFileSync(filePath, { encoding:'utf8', maxBuffer: 1<<20 }));
potential_consequence: Synchronous read with unbounded size blocks event loop at boot
